summary.name: SubManager
summary.one_liner: SubManager is a subscription tracker for Apple devices that keeps all your subscriptions in one list with renewal reminders, spending insights and iCloud sync.
use_cases: track all recurring subscriptions in one place
see monthly and yearly subscription spending
view subscriptions on Apple Watch or Windows browser
summary.what_it_does: SubManager stores a single subscription list that syncs through iCloud across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and Vision Pro. It sends time-sensitive notifications before each renewal and offers Home and Lock Screen widgets showing upcoming charges and totals. Insights show total and remaining spend for the month and year, a monthly average, and breakdowns by category or payment method. Users can pick from a service icon library or import their own icons. SubManager Viewer is a read-only web and Microsoft Store app for checking subscriptions from non-Apple devices.
notable: Native apps across Apple platforms with iCloud sync
Renewal notifications and Home/Lock Screen widgets
Read-only web and Windows viewer for non-Apple devices
Spending insights by category or payment method
caveats: Web and Windows viewer is read-only; editing requires a native Apple device app
Requires iCloud sync for cross-device data and the viewer
Image Playground icon generation only on supported devices
